securityRules: Validate competitive/economy data server-side when available
Do not grant rating or shop currency from unverified combat summaries
rewardsPhilosophy: Fun first, fair second, monetization third. Cosmetics preferred; progression purchases are speed and convenience, not mandatory power.
soloCombatUpdate: Progression now centers individual Titan mastery, one active Titan loadouts, Momentum/Divinity unlocks, stances, reactions, executions, relics, and ascension upgrades.
rosterCollectionUpdate: Players build a main Titan plus specialist roster. Missions recommend tactical advantages but never require ownership of a specific Titan.
onboardingUpdate: Opening sequence awakens one main Titan, teaches solo combat, introduces a radically different second Titan through trial, then opens faction discovery.
